content: {"rules": ["Forecast models consistently overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods.", "Models show significant lag in reacting to sentiment shifts, especially when sentiment spikes.", "Price forecasts often overshoot true outcomes during high volatility or mean-reversion phases.", "Sentiment history with high positive values correlates with higher forecasted prices, but not always with true outcomes.", "Models exhibit bias toward upward trends when recent history shows strong upward momentum.", "Forecast accuracy declines when sentiment is mixed or negative, especially in the absence of clear trend signals.", "True outcomes frequently diverge from forecasts during periods of sharp price correction or mean-reversion.", "Models should adjust for sentiment decay and price momentum when forecasting near historical extremes."]}
